title: Reading Drill — Deciding where to store sandbags — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Deciding where to store sandbags — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Foxhaven, work on bags being collected too far from likely flood sites had already produced a small collection of trial journeys. The local planning team used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: round-trip time to collect supplies.

**B** The group kept smaller depots near streams for the new trial, which was planned to run for four weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that journeys during heavy traffic should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
